articles.title: Healthcare Management Administrators Partners With Carrot To Expand Fertility And Family Care Benefits For Self-Funded Employers
articles.summary: Healthcare Management Administrators (HMA) has announced a strategic partnership with Carrot to integrate comprehensive fertility and family-forming benefits into employer-sponsored health plans across the Pacific Northwest and Michigan. This collaboration matters because employers are increasingly seeking specialized, high-value clinical offerings to attract talent and support holistic employee wellness. For self-funded benefit managers, incorporating targeted family-building solutions presents a dual opportunity to enhance employee satisfaction while better managing overall healthcare and utilization costs associated with modern family care.
articles.source_line: Source: PR Newswire; Wed, 19 Aug 2026 12:00:00 GMT
